description.ja: 深層推論に特化したGLM-4-32Bの派生モデル。数学・コード・論理推論を強化。GLM-Z1-Ruminationは検索ツール統合による熟考モデルでDeep Research対抗。Cold Start + Extended RL、Pairwise Ranking Feedbackで学習。
description.en: GLM-4-32B derivative specialized for deep reasoning. Enhanced math, code, and logical reasoning. GLM-Z1-Rumination is a deliberation model with search tool integration, competing with Deep Research. Trained with Cold Start + Extended RL and Pairwise Ranking Feedback.

description.ja: 深層推論モデル。数学・コード・論理強化。
description.en: Deep reasoning model. Enhanced math, code, and logic.

description.ja: 熟考モデル。検索ツール統合による深層思考。研究スタイルの文章執筆に特化。Deep Research対抗。
description.en: Deliberation model. Deep thinking with search tool integration. Specialized for research-style writing. Competes with Deep Research.

description.ja: 軽量推論モデル。9Bパラメータで深層推論を実現。
description.en: Lightweight reasoning model. Achieves deep reasoning with 9B parameters.
